content.text:
I fixed the look of the site. Both visual snapshots (desktop and phone) now match the approved baselines, so I approved nothing and changed no baselines.

Two edits in `site/css/styles.css` caused the changes:

1. **Button text:** `button, select` had `text-transform: uppercase` (around line 364), so "Cart" and "Add to cart" showed in capitals. I set it back to `none`.
2. **Related products grid:** `.row-cols-xl-4 > *` had `width: 37.5%` (around line 1424), so the cards wrapped into two per row and the page grew by 555px. I set it back to `25%`.

The phone diff was the same uppercase bug, so no separate fix was needed.

STATUS: DONE
